scope: Two sequential instrumented console boots; same browser profile; no production modifications

configuration.verification: Host boot mode/configuration plus guest Memory: 1000576K/1048576K and smp: Brought up 1 node, 2 CPUs

interpretation.dominantDifference: Repeated worker JavaScript dependency loading over the public network while the guest waits for worker readiness
interpretation.sourcePolicy: All Sites logical assets used public, max-age=0, must-revalidate
interpretation.capturedScriptResponses: Status 200 and fromDiskCache=false on both origins; request durations overlap
interpretation.wasmCompilation: Measured totals essentially equal; not an explanation for the 70-second shell gap
interpretation.candidate: Content-addressed immutable worker dependency graph; stable platform and update manifest remain revalidated
interpretation.candidateBrowserAndPublicAcceptance: Local control, Sites v5 public first/warm console boots and separate live module hash/header/manifest checks passed; scoped actual Firefox launch, five JS checksums/download, home update preservation and rendered Google HTTPS page passed (sites-v5-firefox.json)

publicV5LeanAcceptance.observer: Matched page-only lean observer, no worker hooks/pause/tracing
publicV5LeanAcceptance.configuration: Same profile, actual 1 GiB/2 CPU, visible,1280x720 Canvas2D; secure and isolated
publicV5LeanAcceptance.limitation: Single before/first/repeat observations, not a multi-run distribution. This demonstrates public console startup improvement, not a Firefox launch speedup ratio.

localCandidateAcceptance.observer: Page-only Network/Runtime and target discovery; no worker attachment, hooks, pause, tracing or CPU profiler

stableManifest.note: Separate GET; warm active cache did not automatically fetch a new manifest during boot

earlierIntrusiveCandidateRun.failure: Final worker injection timed out, followed by page evaluation timeout; no script HTTP failures or guest RuntimeError captured

localCandidateAcceptance.limitation: Local functional/cache correctness gate only; this is not a measured public speedup

limitations: Constructor/import wrappers, sampled syscall timing, worker attachment and tracing add overhead; no Debugger or CPU Profiler was enabled
Worker resume precedes instrumentation evaluation; first constructor can race capture
Trace filtering did not establish a Wasm optimizing-tier policy difference
Prior 71.30-second/2.65-second observations recorded DOM settings only; their actual configuration match is unverified
Initial failed local report is preserved separately; startup-paused worker injection deadlocked the first harness attempt
